articles.author: Daragh Thomas
articles.headline: 'Big Short' Investor Steve Eisman Says AI Has 'No Moats,' Which Is 'Not A Recipe For Longevity'
articles.summary: Steve Eisman warns AI firms have "no moats" as trillions get spent. Apollo's Slok flags a $500 billion software debt wall and Fed hike risk.
articles._summary: Steve Eisman , the investor made famous by “The Big Short,” warned this week that the artificial intelligence giants driving the stock market may lack the one thing that justifies their spending: a moat. “You’re talking about massive companies spending trillions of dollars for something that may have no moats, and that’s not a recipe for longevity,” Eisman said on the latest episode of his podcast , The Real Eisman Playbook.
articles._zh_headline: “大空头”投资者史蒂夫·艾斯曼表示人工智能“没有护城河”，这“不是长寿的秘诀”
articles._zh_summary: 因《大空头》而出名的投资者史蒂夫·艾斯曼 (Steve Eisman) 本周警告称，推动股市发展的人工智能巨头可能缺乏一项可以证明其支出合理性的东西：护城河。 “你说的是大公司花费数万亿美元购买可能没有护城河的东西，这不是长寿的秘诀，”艾斯曼在他的最新一集播客《真正的艾斯曼剧本》中说道。

articles.author: Kaustubh Bagalkote
articles.headline: Why Is Twin Vee Powercats Stock Surging on Wednesday?
articles.summary: Twin Vee PowerCats Co. (NASDAQ:VEEE) stock surges following a strategic merger with a USFM Corporation subsidiary and the privatization of its marine business.
articles._summary: Following the announcement, Twin Vee closed Monday’s regular trading session at $24.86, representing a 415.77% increase. According to market data, Twin Vee PowerCats maintains a market capitalization of approximately $13.16 million. The equity has traded within a 52-week range of $4.22 to $128.02. Over the past 12 months, VEEE shares have declined by 54.75%. Prior to the restructuring announcement, Twin Vee PowerCats focused its operations on the manufacturing of recreational watercraft.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么 Twin Vee Powercats 股价周三飙升？
articles._zh_summary: 消息公布后，Twin Vee 周一常规交易日收盘价为 24.86 美元，涨幅为 415.77%。根据市场数据，Twin Vee PowerCats 的市值维持在约 1316 万美元。该股 52 周交易价格区间为 4.22 美元至 128.02 美元。过去12个月，VEEE股价下跌54.75%。在宣布重组之前，Twin Vee PowerCats 的业务重点是休闲船只的制造。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: These 10 Stocks Rallied as Producer Inflation Plunged: Here's Why
articles.summary: PPI fell 0.3% in June, the softest since April 2025. Gold miners, BlackRock and Bank of Nova Scotia topped the large-cap pre-market board. Here's why.
articles._summary: Three gold miners, two asset-management giants and a high-flying semiconductor were among the large-cap movers on the pre-market board following a cooler-than-expected producer inflation report on Wednesday. Producer prices fell 0.3% in June, the softest monthly print since April 2025, a day after consumer inflation posted its steepest monthly decline since April 2020.
articles._zh_headline: 随着生产者通胀暴跌，这 10 只股票上涨：原因如下
articles._zh_summary: 在周三发布低于预期的生产者通胀报告后，三大黄金矿商、两家资产管理巨头和一家雄心勃勃的半导体公司成为盘前板块中大盘股的推动者。 6 月份生产者价格下跌 0.3%，为 2025 年 4 月以来最疲软的月度数据，而前一天消费者通胀则创下 2020 年 4 月以来最大幅度的月度跌幅。

articles.author: Daragh Thomas
articles.headline: Apple Intelligence Finally Cleared for China: Here's Which Stocks Are Popping on the News
articles.summary: China approved Apple Intelligence Wednesday, sending Alibaba stock higher as its Qwen AI model powers the long-delayed rollout on iPhones.
articles._summary: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) received Chinese regulatory approval for Apple Intelligence on Wednesday, ending a wait that began with the feature’s launch in 2024. Alibaba Group Holding (NYSE: BABA ) , whose Qwen model will power the service, rose more than 4% in premarket trading. Apple gained close to 1%. The Cyberspace Administration of China added Apple’s generative AI services to its list of approved providers, according to a post on the regulator’s website.
articles._zh_headline: 苹果情报终于为中国清除了：以下是新闻中出现的股票
articles._zh_summary: 苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）周三获得了中国监管机构对 Apple Intelligence 的批准，结束了自 2024 年推出该功能以来的等待。阿里巴巴集团控股公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BABA）的 Qwen 模型将为该服务提供动力，该公司在盘前交易中股价上涨超过 4%。苹果股价上涨近 1%。据监管机构网站上的一篇帖子称，中国国家互联网信息办公室已将苹果的生成式人工智能服务添加到其批准的提供商名单中。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: The Fed Has Missed Its 2% Inflation Target for 64 Straight Months— And One Market Strategist Says It Has 'Lost All Credibility'
articles.summary: Charlie Bilello cites shocking 7-year price hikes as the Fed misses its 2% target for the 64th month, despite a cooling June CPI.
articles._summary: In response to the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) figures, Bilello pointed out that June 2026 marks 64 consecutive months with inflation running above the Federal Reserve’s 2% goal. Reacting to this sustained inflationary period, Bilello declared, “The Fed has lost all credibility when it comes to fighting inflation.” To illustrate the long-term impact on consumers, Bilello shared data tracking severe cumulative “price Increases over last 7 years.”
articles._zh_headline: 美联储连续 64 个月未能实现 2% 的通胀目标——一位市场策略师称其“失去了所有可信度”
articles._zh_summary: 在回应最新的消费者价格指数（CPI）数据时，比莱洛指出，2026年6月标志着通胀率连续64个月高于美联储2%的目标。针对这一持续的通胀时期，比莱洛宣称，“美联储在对抗通胀方面已经失去了所有可信度。”为了说明对消费者的长期影响，Bilello 分享了跟踪“过去 7 年价格上涨”严重累积的数据。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: Why Is Alibaba Stock Surging Wednesday?
articles.summary: Alibaba (NYSE: BABA) stock gains 4% premarket on news that the company's Qwen AI model will power Apple Intelligence on China iPhones.
articles._summary: The broader market also offered modest support, with Nasdaq futures up 0.31% and S&P 500 futures gaining 0.09%. China requires all generative AI services and large language models to be registered before they can be released publicly. Regulators have not announced a launch date, Reuters said. The approval follows Apple’s reported 24.4% year-over-year increase in China iPhone shipments during the second quarter. The latest development adds to improving sentiment around Alibaba.
articles._zh_headline: 为何阿里巴巴股价周三飙升？
articles._zh_summary: 大盘也提供了温和的支撑，纳斯达克期货上涨 0.31%，标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.09%。中国要求所有生成式人工智能服务和大型语言模型必须注册才能公开发布。路透社称，监管机构尚未宣布推出日期。此前，苹果公布第二季度中国 iPhone 出货量同比增长 24.4%。最新进展进一步改善了阿里巴巴的情绪。

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Dismisses Vera Rubin Hardware Delay Report, Affirms 'Giant' Production Volumes
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp. CEO Jensen Huang dismissed reports of delays in the rollout of the company's Vera Rubin AI hardware.
articles._summary: Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ: NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang dismissed reports of delays in the rollout of the company’s Vera Rubin AI hardware and affirmed that production remains on track. On Wednesday, during a talk on how the company could help Japan’s AI ambitions in Tokyo, Huang stated that the company’s high-end AI  accelerator systems were on track for delivery to customers on “giant” production volumes, reported Bloomberg.
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋驳斥了 Vera Rubin 硬件延迟报告，并肯定了“巨大”的产量
articles._zh_summary: 英伟达公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）首席执行官黄仁勋驳斥了有关该公司 Vera Rubin AI 硬件推出延迟的报道，并确认生产仍在正常进行。据彭博社报道，周三，在东京举行的关于该公司如何帮助日本实现人工智能雄心的演讲中，黄仁勋表示，该公司的高端人工智能加速器系统有望以“巨大”的产量交付给客户。

articles.author: Lekha Gupta
articles.headline: Why Is jet.ai Stock Soaring on Wednesday?
articles.summary: Jet.AI Inc. (JTAI)'s stock up in premarket as they announce a non-binding LOI for a proposed merger and spin-off plans for their data center business.
articles._summary: The proposed transaction is expected to be priced at approximately $320 million. This news comes amid a generally positive tone in the market, with S&P 500 futures gaining 0.2%. Under the proposed structure, Jet.AI shareholders would receive about $20 million in value, representing roughly 5%–6% ownership of the combined company. The transaction would allow Jet.AI investors to own shares in two public companies. The merged entity would continue trading under the JTAI ticker.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么jet.ai的股票周三飙升？
articles._zh_summary: 拟议交易预计售价约为 3.2 亿美元。这一消息发布之际，市场普遍乐观，标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.2%。根据拟议的结构，Jet.AI 股东将获得约 2000 万美元的价值，约占合并后公司 5%-6% 的所有权。该交易将允许 Jet.AI 投资者持有两家上市公司的股份。合并后的实体将继续以 JTAI 股票代码进行交易。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: CoreWeave Weighs Derivatives to Protect Against Falling Chip Prices: Report
articles.summary: CoreWeave is reportedly weighing financial derivatives to hedge against future declines in memory and storage chip prices.
articles._summary: CoreWeave Inc. (NASDAQ: CRWV ) is reportedly exploring the use of financial derivatives to hedge against future declines in memory and storage chip prices, Reuters News reported on Tuesday. The company is said to have held early-stage discussions about using financial derivatives, including put options, to protect itself from a future decline in memory and storage chip prices, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles._zh_summary: 据路透社周二报道，CoreWeave Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）正在探索利用金融衍生品来对冲内存和存储芯片价格未来下跌的风险。报道援引知情人士的话称，据称该公司已就使用包括看跌期权在内的金融衍生品进行了早期讨论，以保护自己免受未来内存和存储芯片价格下跌的影响。

The sheer

articles._zh_headline: 人工智能疲劳的加剧是否开始导致标准普尔 500 指数下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 自 2022 年底以来，人工智能一直是整个华尔街最强大的增长驱动力之一，但投资者是否对飙升的估值和循环融资变得不耐烦了？人工智能热潮的规模是前所未有的。目前，“七巨头”是一群在人工智能时代市值不断膨胀的采用者，约占整个标准普尔 500 指数价值的 33%。

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Oracle Leads AWS, Microsoft, Google in Race to Build Japan's Secret Cloud Project to Counter Chinese Hacking Threats: Report
articles.summary: Oracle leads talks on expanding Japan data centers as US ambassador George Glass coordinates with Tokyo and tech rivals.
articles._summary: Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL ) is reportedly leading the race to provide high-security cloud services to Japan. This move is crucial for secure intelligence sharing between Tokyo and its allies. The US has long pushed Japan to strengthen its cybersecurity defenses against Chinese hacking, with the need becoming more urgent as Washington seeks deeper US-Japan weapons co-production and stronger deterrence against China.
articles._zh_headline: 甲骨文领先 AWS、微软、谷歌竞相构建日本秘密云项目以应对中国黑客威胁：报告
articles._zh_summary: 据报道，甲骨文公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ORCL）在向日本提供高安全性云服务的竞争中处于领先地位。此举对于东京及其盟友之间的安全情报共享至关重要。美国长期以来一直敦促日本加强针对中国黑客攻击的网络安全防御，随着华盛顿寻求更深入的美日武器合作和对中国的更强威慑，这一需求变得更加紧迫。

articles.author: Akanksha Bakshi
articles.headline: Pentair Stock Plunges as Pool Destocking Forces Deep 2026 Guidance Cut
articles.summary: Pentair Stock Plunge follows Pool destocking, weaker Q2 estimates and deep 2026 guidance cuts alongside a CFO transition
articles._summary: Pentair expects preliminary second-quarter sales of about $930 million, down 17% year over year. That falls below its previous $1.134 billion guidance and the $1.137 billion analyst estimate. Adjusted EPS is expected at approximately $1.12, down from the prior outlook of $1.47 to $1.50 and below the $1.48 estimate. GAAP EPS from continuing operations is expected at about 80 cents, versus the previous guidance of $1.39 to $1.42 and the $1.37 estimate.
articles._zh_headline: 由于库存去化导致 2026 年指导大幅下调，Pentair 股价暴跌
articles._zh_summary: Pentair预计第二季度初步销售额约为9.3亿美元，同比下降17%。这低于之前的 11.34 亿美元指导值和 11.37 亿美元分析师预期。调整后每股收益预计约为 1.12 美元，低于之前预期的 1.47 美元至 1.50 美元，也低于预期的 1.48 美元。持续经营业务的 GAAP 每股收益预计约为 80 美分，而之前的指引为 1.39 美元至 1.42 美元，预估为 1.37 美元。

articles.author: Eva Mathew
articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
articles.summary: July 15, 2026: Polymarket traders expect the S&P 500 to open higher on Wednesday after cooler inflation sharply reduced July Fed hike expectations.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 ended higher on Tuesday after a softer-than-expected inflation report boosted hopes that the Federal Reserve may not need to tighten monetary policy as aggressively this year. Polymarket traders now expect the benchmark index to extend those gains at Wednesday’s open. The S&P 500 rose 0.38% to close at 7,543.59. The July 15 Polymarket contract implied a 73% probability that the index will open higher on Wednesday.
articles._zh_headline: 股市：今天标普 500 指数会上涨还是下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 周二，标准普尔 500 指数收高，此前疲软的通胀报告提振了人们对美联储今年可能不需要如此激进收紧货币政策的希望。 Polymarket 交易员现在预计基准指数将在周三开盘时延续涨幅。标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.38%，收于 7,543.59 点。 7 月 15 日 Polymarket 合约暗示该指数周三高开的可能性为 73%。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Chamath Palihapitiya Says Meta and Elon Musk Could End the '$50 Barrel of Intelligence' Era, Challenging Rivals OpenAI and Anthropic
articles.summary: Chamath Palihapitiya warns Meta and xAI will crush expensive AI models as a '$50 barrel of intelligence' price war looms.
articles._summary: “You can buy it from OpenAI for 26 bucks. Anthropic’s latest model costs you 56 bucks,” Palihapitiya explained . But as deep-pocketed competitors release models that he estimates are “80 to 95% as good,” those premium prices are becoming increasingly difficult for the market to justify. “Elon is selling you a barrel of intelligence for a buck. Zuck is about to sell it to you for a buck 50. Demis and Sundar are trying to sell it to you for a dollar. The Chinese will sell it to you for $0.50,” he noted.
articles._zh_headline: Chamath Palihapitiya 表示 Meta 和 Elon Musk 可能会结束“50 美元一桶智能”时代，挑战竞争对手 OpenAI 和 Anthropic
articles._zh_summary: “你可以花 26 美元从 OpenAI 购买它。Anthropic 的最新模型售价 56 美元，”Palihapitiya 解释道。但随着财力雄厚的竞争对手发布了他估计“80% 到 95% 的质量”的型号，市场越来越难以证明这些溢价是合理的。 “埃隆正在以 1 美元的价格卖给你一桶情报。扎克正准备以 50 美元的价格卖给你。戴米斯和桑达尔正试图以 1 美元的价格卖给你。中国人会以 0.5 美元的价格卖给你，”他指出。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: YSX Tech Stock Soars 14% After Hours: Here's Why
articles.summary: YSX Tech Co Ltd shares jumped 14.10% after hours following its fiscal 2026 earnings report showing revenue growth.
articles._summary: YSX Tech Co Ltd (NASDAQ: YSXT ) shares jumped 14.10% to $0.80 in after-hours trading on Tuesday. The surge in the late session reverses an intraday decline of 0.53%, which closed the stock of the Chinese business solutions provider at $0.70, according to the Benzinga Pro data. The stock movement came after the company released its fiscal 2026 earnings report for the year ended Mar. 31. Total revenue increased 16.8% year over year to $83.5 million, supported by a 28.8% increase in service volumes.
articles._zh_headline: YSX 科技股盘后飙升 14%：原因如下
articles._zh_summary: YSX Tech Co Ltd（纳斯达克股票代码：YSXT）股价周二盘后交易中上涨 14.10%，至 0.80 美元。根据 Benzinga Pro 的数据，尾盘的飙升扭转了盘中 0.53% 的跌幅，这家中国商业解决方案提供商的股价收于 0.70 美元。该股票走势是在该公司发布截至 3 月 31 日的 2026 财年收益报告后发生的。在服务量增长 28.8% 的支撑下，总收入同比增长 16.8% 至 8350 万美元。

articles.headline: PayPal Stock Surges Nearly 15% in Premarket as Stripe and Advent International Reportedly Propose $53 Billion Joint Acquisition

articles._summary: June’s inflation report delivered a pleasant surprise, with the annual CPI rate falling to 3.5%. The data was released just hours before new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s first congressional testimony, giving investors fresh insight into how the Fed’s policy outlook could evolve from here. Strip out food and energy, and there was zero inflation last month. That’s the number that matters most for what happens next. One day before this report, Fed Governor Waller warned that a hot core print could force the FOMC to consider hiking. Well, the report came in flat instead, meaning that the hawkish case is now effectively off the table. The flat core print is the first genuinely clean signal in months that underlying price pressures are breaking, rather than just easing on the back of temporary swings in energy costs.

articles._zh_summary: 6月通胀报告令人惊喜，CPI年率回落至3.5%。该数据是在美联储新任主席凯文·沃什首次在国会作证前几个小时发布的，让投资者对美联储的政策前景如何演变有了新的了解。除去食品和能源，上个月通胀为零。这是对接下来发生的事情最重要的数字。在这份报告发布前一天，美联储理事沃勒警告称，一份热门的核心报告可能会迫使联邦公开市场委员会考虑加息。然而，该报告的结果却持平，这意味着鹰派的观点现在实际上已经不被讨论了。扁平核心打印是几个月来第一个真正明确的信号，表明潜在的价格压力正在突破，而不仅仅是因能源成本暂时波动而缓解。
